pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal dark regions with diffuse, low-contrast edge gradients. The patches exhibit a medium spatial area on the mid-flank, with a notable transition to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological web. Intersection nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of the pathways is greatest on the neck and thins consistently as the network progresses toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, characterized by a dark fringe of varying pixel density against the blurred background.
